Remark
[Implicit formula for the conservation law] ↗ ex:characteristics-conservation-laws 1. ch3:3.2.5-rem-1\group Conservation Laws

Before characteristic crossing, the solution satisfies \[ u(x,t)=g(x-tF'(u(x,t))). \] The implicit function theorem applies while \[ 1+tDg(x-tF'(u))\cdot F''(u)\ne 0. \]
